The '''Model 16 hold-out''' was a type of [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] manufactured by the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]]. The hold-out blaster could fire at least twenty shots and required a spare [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]] for more shots.<ref name="COO" /> 

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] used the blaster to defend himself while he, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Vestin Axlon]], and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] were under attack in his office by agents of the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]].<ref name="COO" />
